neighbours.label: The object determiner after possessive 'have' / 'avoir' ('we have a lot to', 'nous avons une'), vs the same determiner after other verbs
fire: Honestly, we have a great deal to be thankful for this year.
The hospital still has a long list of patients waiting for surgery.
Nous avons une grande responsabilité envers nos enfants.
After the election, the party has a lot of work ahead of it.
Our team has a clear plan for the next three months.
Les chercheurs ont une nouvelle piste à explorer.
Every town has a story that deserves to be told.
As a nation, we have a duty to protect these forests.
quiet: Honestly, we did a great deal of cleaning this year.
The hospital still sent a long list of patients to the clinic.
Nous lisons une grande histoire à nos enfants.
After the election, the party did a lot of work in the north.
Our team drew a clear chart for the next three months.
Les chercheurs suivent une nouvelle piste depuis mars.
Every town built a statue near the old market.
As a nation, we planted a million trees in these forests.

notes: Card: ' a' x7 after has/have ('We have a lot to thank', 'the job market has a long way to go'), ' our' x2, ' une' after avons, ' unser'. Probe: 'Nous avons une longue route' 0.532, 'We have a lot to learn' 0.477, 'city still has a long way to go' 0.339, 'unser Leben' 0.261, 'Our homes' 0.219; 'We saw a lot of birds' 0.143, 'Their homes' 0.023.
